items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: Then when -- we had a drummer named Wilbur Kirk

ctx.x: and the bass player's getting ready to quit, you'd say to the band leader, let's get so-and-so. So Walter Page had been a friend of Pillars' so when Jimmy Blanton went to Duke, he said, well, let's see if we can get Walter Page, which he was living in Kansas City, which is only a few short miles from St. Louis. So we got Walter Page.
Then when -- we had a drummer named Wilbur Kirk, went to Noble Sissle's band, and that's the first time I met Lena Horne. She was a vocalist with Noble Sissle.
Wilbur Kirk, didn't he end up with that Sidney -- went to Paris?
